liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **I Play It Off Legit**: rare: 13 archived performances [7]

## The recordings

- **ween2016-08-23.schoeps.mk4v.sxr4.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 31 songs; 156 min [1]
- **ween2016-08-23.schoeps.mk4v.sxr4.flac16**: source not stated; 31 songs; 156 min [2]
- **ween2016-08-23.schoeps.mk41v.sxr4.flac16**: source not stated; 31 songs; 156 min [4]
- **ween2016-08-23.mg200**: source not stated; 31 songs; 154 min [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2016-08-23.schoeps.mk4v.sxr4.flac24**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk4v>nbob actives>Naiant PFAs>Sonosax SX-R4 (24bit/96khz) [1]
- **ween2016-08-23.schoeps.mk4v.sxr4.flac16**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk4v>nbob actives>Naiant PFAs>Sonosax SX-R4 (24bit/96khz) [2]. Also: Transfer went by USB to an iMac, tracked in Audacity, resampled and dithered in Soundforge to 16-bit/44.1k, then encoded to FLAC [2]
- **ween2016-08-23.schoeps.mk41v.sxr4.flac16**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk41v>kc5>cmc6>Sonosax SX-R4 (24bit/96khz) [4]. Also: Chain: WAV over USB to iMac, Audacity tracking and fades, Soundforge resampling and dither to 16/44.1, then FLAC encoding [4]
- **ween2016-08-23.mg200**: taped by Jason Adler; transferred by Jason Adler; source: Microtech Gefell M200's(DIN)>Audio Magic Hyper Conductors>Edirol R-4 (Oade T-Mod) @ 24/96 [5]. Also: Transferred from the R-4 by USB to PC, tracked, resampled and dithered to 16/44.1 in Adobe Audition 3, then encoded with FLAC Frontend [5]
